nvme.LinkSpeed: The signalling rate of ONE PCIe lane, in the kernel's own label. Not the link's total — multiply by LinkWidth for that.
nvme.LinkWidth: How many PCIe lanes are actually carrying traffic. The link's bandwidth is LinkSpeed multiplied by this.
nvme.LinkWidthMax: How many lanes the device can use when a slot provides them.
nvme.SlotLinkWidthMax: How many lanes the slot is physically wired for, read from the bridge above the device. A property of the board, which no configuration can change.
nvme.LinkBandwidthBytesPerSec: Derived, not read: LinkSpeed's per-lane throughput after PCIe line encoding, times LinkWidth. Each direction — PCIe is full duplex.

scsi.LinkSpeed: The rate this SATA or SAS link negotiated. One serial connection, so unlike PCIe there is no lane count to multiply.
